request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A sheet can now give a user the **viewer** role, and a viewer can't change anything. All 4 Playwright tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**How it works**
- **Server-side block:** a new Spring MVC interceptor, `ViewerGuard.java`, is registered in `SpaConfig`. It refuses any request on a sheet that isn't a read (anything but a GET or loading the sheet) when the signed-in user is a viewer. The refusal is a 403, so the screen shows that form's or action's usual error. The request never reaches its controller, so nothing is written to the store or the audit file. This covers every form and action, including the sheet's today, statements, holds, the paste box, quick-add, settings, rates, roles and the claim actions.
- **Bulk buttons:** bulk open and bulk settle get past the guard. `BulkChangeService` answers a viewer with 0 changed and every selected claim refused, and no error shows.
- **Stored data:** `Role` gains `VIEWER`. A new migration, `V34__role_viewer.sql`, rebuilds the `sheet_role` table so the stored role can also be `'viewer'`. It rebuilds rather than alters because the original check constraint has no name to drop.
- **Front end:** `viewer` is added to the role list, and the role form's label and error messages now mention it.

**Coverage gaps**
- **Buttons that don't exist yet:** the request names bulk reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date and void, and generate buttons for periods, fiscal years, quarters and plans. Only bulk open and settle exist in this app. Any new request (anything but a read or load) will be refused for a viewer automatically. A new bulk or generate endpoint will also be refused with an error, unless it is added to the guard's pass-through list and gives a viewer an all-refused result the way bulk open and settle do.
- **Not tested end to end:** the tests don't press a bulk button as a viewer, so the 0-done, all-refused counts haven't been checked in the browser.
